constructionBoundary.src/features/dashboard/commands/configur: Boundary file constructing ComponentRegistryManager directly, alongside 3 ServiceLocator fetch(es) — MIXES both styles in one file. DEFERRED 2026-08-29 while its three siblings converted: those are handlers that already RECEIVE a HandlerContext, so they just read the registry off it. This is a command that builds its context on demand, and routing a registry read through createHandlerContext drags in PrerequisitesManager, the ServiceLocator and the logger — a heavier graph than the read needs, and getInitialData's test proved it by failing on each in turn. Needs the registry handed to the command itself, not fetched through a handler context.
